reviewProcess: Codex full-tree source review, stated primary-reference checks and recorded local probes. Official protected merge review is recorded separately by the PR workflow.
selectionBasis: Top 20 canonical skills by occurrences in checked-in workflows and focused editorial bundles, ties by ID; editorial prominence, not user telemetry.
hashContract: File bytes SHA-256; tree SHA-256 over lexicographically path-sorted UTF-8 lines: <mode> <sha256> <repo-path>\n. Metadata outside these trees is not bound. Later byte or mode changes make the corresponding snapshot stale, not automatically invalid.
